judge.reason: The plan avoids running all three ~6 GB builds at once: it caps concurrency at two (about 12 GB of 16 GB), limits workers because of the usage limit, and offers fully serial execution as a lower-budget option. However, it still runs two heavy builds and two workers near the limit rather than one build lane, and it never plans for a worker killed by the usage limit to be retried from resumable state as an environment failure; it only says it 'wouldn't retry blindly' after a build failure.
